description: What the main window is permitted to do. Deliberately small: every addition here widens what a compromised frontend could reach, and BibleCompose's frontend renders content that arrived by email. `dialog:allow-open` is the folder picker and nothing else -- not save, not message, not ask -- because choosing a project is the one thing the window needs the filesystem for. Its own commands are granted by name (`allow-…`), because they are declared in build.rs so that the editor windows (capabilities/editor.json) are refused them.
